title: Great tour, great tour guide
text: Great tour, great tour guide. Tour guide was knowledgeable and engaging. Nice walk in between sites. I would do this again.
author: Colin_C

title: Great way to see how...
text: Great way to see how Gaudi’s career in homes started and transformed.  Wonderful walking tour and learned even more about the distinct neighborhoods.
author: Stacey_J

title: Get to Know Gaudi’s Work
text: We were shown three of the Gaudi homes. We were not allowed to see them entirely but were given enough to get a good idea of what they are like. Our guide Duong (sp?) was a fantastic guide. Knowledgeable about Gaudi and his work, was very kind to us, patient, and answered all our questions. I did not feel rushed.
author: G4513DGjudyt

title: Loved this tour Katrina’s commentary was insightful and fun
text: There is some walking involved between the house and no time for shopping it’s all about Gaudí and the houses
author: Suzanne_S

title: Unique Homes
text: Gaudí homes are beyond beautiful, they are unique.  Our guide brought them to life for us, s well as showing us the history of Guadi.  He was unique and before his time.  The elements that he u from earth and sea were great.
author: Kathy_V

title: Amazing Gaudi houses tour
text: Very informative and interesting tour of the Gaudi houses. Jane was our tour guide and her wealth of knowledge was incredible. She also presented the information with a genuine enthusiasm. This tour included the Casa Vicens, the first Gaudi house which is beautiful and most of the time not always included in typical tours. This was a big plus.
author: Maria_V

title: Beautiful Tour!!!
text: This was a great tour definitely the best part of my trip to Spain! Jane was an awesome tour guide that was extremely knowledgeable, I’m so happy and I would definitely recommend it:)
author: C9931DEabbyb

title: Gaudi houses
text: This was a very informative and interesting tour about Gaudi. The houses were very different but beautiful
author: Terry_H

title: Beauty to behold
text: Lots of walking and steps but a wonderful experience.  You learn a lot about Audi and the culture of the era.
author: dianetesta

title: This tour is a must do...
text: This tour is a must do for Barcelona. Three of the most famous Gaudi houses in BCN. Estrella was very knowledgeable!
author: Lee_G
